list.name: stream
list.label: Data stream
list.query: SELECT __text,__value FROM (SELECT 'Latest live' AS __text,'__latest_live__' AS __value,0 AS priority UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT stream AS __text,stream AS __value,1 AS priority FROM telemetry) AS streams ORDER BY priority,__text

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN observed_at < now()-INTERVAL '10 seconds' THEN 2 WHEN up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status
FROM telemetry WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND link_id='wan1' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN observed_at < now()-INTERVAL '10 seconds' THEN 2 WHEN up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status
FROM telemetry WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND link_id='wan2' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(payload->'pending'->>'target','None') AS target FROM state WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND key='service_status'

SELECT extract(epoch from now()-updated_at)::double precision AS age FROM state WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND key='service_status'
SELECT (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS live_stream

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN payload->>'kind'='real_traffic' THEN CASE WHEN payload->>'active'='true' AND updated_at > now()-INTERVAL '25 seconds' THEN 'Real traffic; capacity-emulated WANs (100 / 80 / 30 Mbps)' WHEN payload->>'active'='true' THEN 'Real traffic status stale (check runner)' ELSE 'Real traffic stopped; capacity-emulated WANs' END WHEN payload->>'active'='true' AND updated_at > now()-INTERVAL '25 seconds' THEN 'Natural WAN: Fiber / Broadband / Mobile' WHEN payload->>'active'='true' THEN 'Natural WAN status stale (check runner)' ELSE 'Natural WAN stopped' END FROM state WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND key='wan_environment'), 'Natural WAN not enabled') AS environment

SELECT payload->'last_decision'->>'action' AS action,
upper(payload->'last_decision'->>'source') AS source,
upper(payload->'last_decision'->>'target') AS target,
payload->'last_decision'->>'reason' AS reason,
upper(payload->'apply_inflight'->>'target') AS applying,
extract(epoch from now()-updated_at)::double precision AS age_seconds
FROM state WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND key='service_status'

panels.title: ML 30s forecasts and measured WAN quality

targets.rawSql:
SELECT upper(wan.key) AS wan,
CASE WHEN now() - to_timestamp((wan.value->>'timestamp')::double precision) > INTERVAL '10 seconds'
THEN 'STALE' WHEN (wan.value->>'up')::boolean THEN 'UP' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS status,
CASE WHEN (wan.value->>'up')::boolean THEN (wan.value->>'latency_ms')::double precision END AS measured_rtt_ms,
(payload->'last_decision'->'predicted'->wan.key->>0)::double precision AS forecast_rtt_30s_ms,
CASE WHEN (wan.value->>'up')::boolean THEN (wan.value->>'jitter_ms')::double precision END AS measured_jitter_ms,
(payload->'last_decision'->'predicted'->wan.key->>1)::double precision AS forecast_jitter_30s_ms,
(wan.value->>'loss_pct')::double precision AS measured_loss_pct,
(payload->'last_decision'->'predicted'->wan.key->>2)::double precision AS forecast_loss_30s_pct,
(wan.value->>'utilization_pct')::double precision AS measured_utilization_pct,
(payload->'last_decision'->'predicted'->wan.key->>3)::double precision AS forecast_utilization_30s_pct,
(payload->'last_decision'->'scores'->>wan.key)::double precision AS decision_score
FROM state CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(payload->'telemetry') AS wan
WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND state.key='service_status' ORDER BY wan.key

panels.description: Forecasts combine the experimental XGBoost model with persistence for disabled metrics. Lower decision score is preferred among paths meeting the current SLA. Blank forecasts mean down/stale or insufficient continuous history; they are not zero. RTT/jitter are ICMP round-trip mean/stddev. Sudden-down failover is a policy rule.

panels.title: Real traffic workload session

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
WHEN payload->>'active'='true' AND updated_at > now()-INTERVAL '25 seconds' THEN 'RUNNING'
WHEN payload->>'active'='true' THEN 'STALE (check runner)' ELSE 'STOPPED' END AS status,
payload->>'run_id' AS run_id, payload->>'phase' AS phase,
COALESCE(payload->>'mode',payload->>'kind') AS traffic_mode,
payload->>'capacity_emulated' AS capacity_emulated,
(payload->>'delay_injected_ms')::double precision AS injected_delay_ms,
(payload->>'loss_injected_pct')::double precision AS injected_loss_pct,
updated_at AS last_heartbeat,
extract(epoch from now()-updated_at)::double precision AS heartbeat_age_seconds,
payload->'application'->'http'->>'success' AS latest_http_success,
payload->'application'->'download'->>'success' AS latest_download_success,
payload->'application'->'udp'->>'success' AS latest_udp_success
FROM state WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND key='application_workload'

panels.description: Workload runner heartbeat and latest endpoint measurement outcomes. A stale or stopped session is not a current healthy measurement. Capacity-emulated lab WANs carry real packets; no real ISP behavior is implied.

panels.title: Endpoint HTTP response time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, 'HTTP response' AS metric,
CASE WHEN payload->>'success'='true' THEN (payload->>'latency_ms')::double precision END AS value
FROM events WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND kind='application_measurement'
AND payload->>'application'='http' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at,id

panels.description: Measured at the workload endpoint using real packets in the lab. Failed or missing measurements are gaps, not zero. The WAN capacities are emulated; these are not measurements from three real ISPs.

panels.title: Endpoint UDP RTT / RTT variation

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, timing.metric,
CASE WHEN payload->>'success'='true' THEN timing.value END AS value
FROM events CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
('UDP RTT stddev', (payload->>'jitter_ms')::double precision),
('Measured RTT', COALESCE(payload->>'rtt_ms',payload->>'latency_ms')::double precision)
) AS timing(metric,value)
WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND kind='application_measurement'
AND payload->>'application'='udp' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at,id,metric

panels.description: Measured at the workload endpoint using real packets in the lab. Failed or missing measurements are gaps, not zero. The WAN capacities are emulated; these are not measurements from three real ISPs. UDP echo reports mean round-trip latency and its standard deviation. RTT is shown only when an echo is received; it is not converted into one-way latency.

panels.title: Per-WAN background load: offered and received

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time,
upper(payload->>'link_id') || ' ' || COALESCE(payload->>'direction',payload->>'side','') || ' ' || traffic.metric AS metric,
CASE WHEN payload->>'success'='true' THEN traffic.value END AS value
FROM events CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
('offered', (payload->>'offered_mbps')::double precision),
('received', (payload->>'received_mbps')::double precision)
) AS traffic(metric,value)
WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND kind='background_measurement'
AND payload->>'link_id' IN ('wan1','wan2','wan3') AND $__timeFilter(observed_at)
ORDER BY observed_at,id,metric

panels.description: Real background packets compete for each WAN's shared bottleneck separately. Offered is sender-measured throughput; received is receiver-measured goodput. These external background packets do not enter the edge VPP utilization counters. Failed or missing measurements are gaps, not zero.

panels.title: Endpoint measurement outcomes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time,
payload->>'run_id' AS run_id, payload->>'phase' AS phase,
payload->>'application' AS application,
CASE WHEN payload->>'success'='true' THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'FAILED / INCOMPLETE' END AS status,
CASE WHEN payload->>'success'='true' THEN (payload->>'latency_ms')::double precision END AS latency_ms,
CASE WHEN payload->>'success'='true' THEN (payload->>'received_mbps')::double precision END AS received_mbps,
CASE WHEN payload->>'success'='true' THEN (payload->>'loss_pct')::double precision END AS loss_pct,
payload->>'error' AS error
FROM events WHERE stream=CASE WHEN ${stream:sqlstring}='__latest_live__' THEN (SELECT stream FROM state WHERE key='service_status' AND payload->>'backend' IN ('flexiwan','flexiwan_observe') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ${stream:sqlstring} END AND kind='application_measurement' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at)
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Individual measurement times, phases and outcomes remain visible even when a test fails. Charts show successful measurements only; failed measurements never become healthy zeros.
